note: Sample rooms. Write your own in this file (CLAUDE.md has the format).

plants.title: The drawer nobody opens
plants.instructions: Every house has one drawer that collects everything. Don't sort the whole house. Pick that one drawer and decide what to do with it.
plants.ask: Which drawer, and when will you empty it? Write the day and the time.

treasure.name: Brass gear
treasure.description: Twelve teeth, one of them chipped. It still turns.

treasure.name: Small iron key
treasure.description: Nobody remembers which lock it opens.

notes.title: On a fence post
notes.text: Small jobs with a time on them get done. Big jobs with no time on them get carried around.

plants.title: Why the deep is warm
plants.instructions: The deeper a mine goes, the warmer the rock gets: a few degrees for every hundred metres, from heat left over inside the planet and from rock that is slowly decaying.
plants.ask: Write one thing you would want to know before going a kilometre down.

treasure.name: Warm crystal
treasure.description: It holds the heat of the rock it grew in.

treasure.name: Spiral shell
treasure.description: From a sea that was here before the jungle was.
